ssh.exec [exec] on ssh.host: env unknown, owner unknown, admin unknown, ad hoc — as human
Decision: deny (would be blocked once enforced).
Policy:   the built-in baseline (no snapshot is applied)

Matched rules:
  approve  baseline.exec.human    the baseline requires approval for a human's exec operation
  deny     builtin.admin-unknown  nobody declared who administers this target, so it is read as the owner's (label it with admin:)

Enforcement: shadow for this call: the decision is recorded and nothing is refused.

Credentials: ssh/key (the legacy chain).

Break glass: gets past an approve, never a deny; at most 3 per target per 24h0m0s.
Circuit breaker: off (policy sets no circuit_breaker).

Posture:  secure, from the global posture (evaluated in shadow, like every decision above)
